rfp.subject: Board meeting enquiry: 12 guests, 1 night, arriving 2027-04-08
rfp.body:
Hello,

Demo Co. is planning a board meeting and would like a proposal for the following.

Arrival: 2027-04-08, departure 2027-04-09 (1 night)
Guests: 12, single-occupancy rooms (12 room nights)
Meeting space: one private boardroom for 12 for the day. No breakout rooms are needed.
Catering: lunch and coffee breaks. Dietary needs: none reported. Please confirm you can cater for vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free requests if they come up.
Accessibility: 0 wheelchair users.
Priorities: a quiet, discreet setting, and a harbour view if possible.
Budget: up to EUR 8,000 in total.

Please send your availability, a full price and your terms by 2026-10-25.

Kind regards,
Demo Co. Events
